diagnosis: The helper was routed only through ApplyRuntimeControlTuning. LocomotionActiveShell is intentionally classified as a causal policy-control state, and TickLogic skips ApplyRuntimeControlTuning for all causal policy-control states. Production locomotion gains are republished by PublishStandingActivationFrame instead, so E70 could not affect active controls.
decision: Reject E70 and revert its behavior changes. Test the same existing lower-limb damping profile in the authoritative production gain publisher as a separately preregistered experiment.
